monetization.noteEs: Free-to-play con monetización exclusivamente cosmética y desbloqueo de campeones. Todos los campeones se pueden conseguir gratis con currency in-game (Blue Essence) farmeable jugando partidas. Las skins son puramente cosméticas, no afectan gameplay. Las loot boxes (Hextech Chests) se obtienen jugando, no requieren compra obligatoria. No es pay-to-win en ningún sentido competitivo.
monetization.noteEn: Free-to-play with exclusively cosmetic and champion unlock monetization. All champions can be obtained free with in-game currency (Blue Essence) farmable by playing matches. Skins are purely cosmetic, don't affect gameplay. Loot boxes (Hextech Chests) are obtained by playing, don't require mandatory purchase. Not pay-to-win in any competitive sense.
